Do you enjoy working through complex mechanical problems, questioning assumptions, and understanding why a design behaves the way it does?

At RD8, you will work hands-on with mechanical product development, using analysis and practical design work to solve challenging client problems. You will join an international team of mechanical engineers in a dedicated technical environment where specialist expertise is central to the work as part of a dynamic start-up

This role is for engineers who want to stay close to the engineering work and don’t shy away from the hard and interesting challenges where you have to use all of your toolbox

About RD8

We help companies that cannot afford to get it wrong make better engineering design decisions. Through consulting, software and ventures, we strengthen how mechanical R&D teams think, design and deliver.

Our aim is to make Robust Design an everyday engineering practice.

Our engineering ecosystem brings together specialist knowledge, training, documentation and software.

We work with R&D, operations and manufacturing organizations across industries, including major international companies, to make mechanical products less sensitive to variation.

What you will do

As a Robust Design Consultant, you will work directly on clients’ mechanical design challenges. You will investigate how parts interact, how tolerances affect function, and how designs can be improved.

The role combines engineering work with client dialogue and technical responsibility for project delivery.

• Work with small teams to design, analyse, and improve mechanical products. We work either inside our client’s teams or as more independent teams.

• Develop solutions for new products across several industries.

• Analyse and improve existing products in a range of industries.

• Create data-driven transparency in your solutions to improve decision-making.

• Explain findings and design recommendations to clients, help deliver projects, and coordinate technical work within the team.

You will be working on these tasks with frontrunners within the area of Robust Design - experts on a global level, in a start-up with global ambitions.

We are continuously developing our framework and adopting or creating solutions for our engineering ecosystem.

There’s a short way from decision to action and a high degree of freedom to shape the company and solutions. Great opportunities to take responsibility and for shaping business areas going forward

Your background

We welcome engineers with two or more years of relevant professional experience, ideally in mechanical product development, as well as senior specialists who want to deepen their expertise and remain hands-on.

• A master’s degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

• Strong analytical skills across mechanical function, tolerance variation, and solid mechanics.

• Knowledge of Robust Design principles.

• Knowledge of production technologies and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).

• Fluent English.

Additional experience we value

• Working knowledge of statistical methods and finite element simulation methods.

• Experience with prototyping tools and methods.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Danish or German language skills.

• Advanced simulation expertise.

Location and travel

This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters at Strandboulevarden 122, 3rd floor, 2100 Copenhagen, Denmark.

Expect 0–20 travel days per year.

Why join RD8

• Work alongside Robust Design specialists on mechanical challenges across products and industries.

• Have a high degree of freedom in how you approach your work and contribute to the methods and tools we develop.

• Flexibility to work from home when project and client commitments allow, with support for a home office setup

• Optional monthly social events, a subsidized lunch scheme and coffee, tea and snacks at the office.

• Take on responsibility and help shape our services and business areas as the company develops.

Apply

If you're a problem-solver who is excited about working on cutting-edge technology to create world-class solutions, then apply now with your CV

For further information about the position, contact Casper Høgh at csh@ing.dk

• Valid driving license and willingness to travel up to 60 days per year

Personal characteristics

• Hands-on and motivated by solving technical challenges

• Works independently and takes ownership of tasks and projects

• Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills with a proactive mindset

• Comfortable working across electrical, mechanical, and automation disciplines

• Reliable, adaptable, and willing to go the extra mile to ensure successful project delivery

Our Client offers

_At AGC Biologics, we are constantly developing our manufacturing capabilities to support the delivery of life-changing biologics to patients worldwide. As our new OT Operations Specialist, you will play an important role in maintaining and improving the Operational Technology landscape that supports our GMP-regulated manufacturing environment.

You will work at the intersection of technology, manufacturing, and quality, ensuring that our systems are reliable, compliant, and ready to support future digitalization initiatives. This role offers the opportunity to work with advanced manufacturing technologies while collaborating with experts across Automation, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and IT.

**A key role in our Operational Technology landscape

**As a OT Operations Specialist, you will help ensure stable and compliant manufacturing systems while supporting continuous improvements across our digital production environment.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

****Operational Technology

**

• Support and maintain OT infrastructure and manufacturing systems in a GMP-regulated production environment.

• Manage OT servers, virtualization platforms, industrial networks, and system integrations.

• Troubleshoot complex OT-related issues across manufacturing environments.

• Collaborate closely with Automation, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and IT teams to ensure reliable operations.

**GMP & Compliance

**

• Ensure OT systems remain compliant with GMP requirements and data integrity principles (ALCOA+).

• Drive and support Change Controls (CRs), Deviations, CAPAs, and Risk Assessments related to OT systems.

• Support audits, inspections, and periodic system reviews.

• Contribute to Computer System Validation (CSV) activities, including IQ/OQ documentation and execution.

**Digitalization & Integration

**

• Support integration between manufacturing systems and business systems.

• Participate in digitalization initiatives involving MES, Historian, SCADA, ERP, and related manufacturing platforms.

• Support industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA, Modbus, and Profinet.

• Drive continuous improvements and identify opportunities for automation and increased operational efficiency.

**Security & Lifecycle Management

**

• Support OT cybersecurity initiatives and contribute to maintaining a secure technology environment.

• Manage system lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, backup, disaster recovery, and access management.

• Ensure systems remain secure, reliable, and inspection-ready.

**A collaborative environment with room to make an impact

**You will join a team where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are key parts of how we work. You will work closely with colleagues across different functions and act as a trusted technology partner to Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality Assurance, and IT.

Success in this role means maintaining a stable and compliant OT environment, driving GMP-related improvements, strengthening system integrations, and identifying opportunities where technology can improve our manufacturing processes.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings

**You have a strong interest in combining technology with manufacturing and thrive in an environment where quality, compliance, and reliability are essential.

**We Imagine That You Have

**

• A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Automation, Computer Science, or a similar field.

• 5+ years of experience within OT, Manufacturing IT, Automation, or Life Sciences.

• Strong understanding of GMP-regulated environments.

• Experience managing Change Controls, Deviations, CAPAs, and validation activities.

• Experience working with OT infrastructure, servers, virtualization, and industrial networking.

• Experience working with manufacturing systems such as SCADA, Historian, MES, or similar platforms.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

**It Is An Advantage If You Have Experience With

**

• MES platforms and manufacturing system integrations.

• APIs and data flows between systems.

• Industrial communication protocols such as OPC UA, Modbus, or Profinet.

• OT cybersecurity frameworks and best practices.

• Supporting FDA, EMA, or other regulatory inspections.

**Why join AGC Biologics?

**At AGC Biologics, you will have the opportunity to shape the future OT landscape and digital manufacturing strategy while working in a highly regulated and technologically advanced production environment.

You will collaborate with talented colleagues across a global organization where innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. Your work will directly contribute to ensuring reliable manufacturing processes that help bring important biologic therapies to patients worldwide.

**Join our team

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible. Please submit your application no later than 15 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

If you have any questions about the position, **please contact Jimmy Jespersen, Director of IT, at jimmy.jespersen@agc.com

**Please apply exclusively through our recruitment system. Applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To support an inclusive and unbiased recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your CV. At AGC Biologics, we are committed to fair hiring practices and value diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process.

Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

At Weibel, you will join a rapidly growing, family-owned technology company where curiosity, innovation, and dedication form the foundation of our success. As our new Sub System Architect you will play a key role in shaping the design of our radar solutions. You will work alongside talented, committed colleagues who share a passion for technology.

We are expanding our team and are looking for a Sub System Architect to lead the architecture of key subsystems e.g., pedestals, trailers, cooling, or power from concept to verification. You will translate system needs into robust solutions, interfaces, and guide cross‑disciplinary design through specification, reviews, integration, and test. Verifying and developing designs is done by review, simulations, and prototyping.

Your impact

• Be responsible for the subsystem architecture: define purpose, scope, block diagrams, interfaces, BOM structure, and key design decisions.

• Requirements flow‑down & compliance: allocate system requirements to subsystem level, maintain compliance matrices/SoC, and support traceability through design, test, and verification.

• Interface leadership: specify and manage interfaces to neighboring subsystems and external equipment and ensure early alignment.

• Design coordination: collaborate with engineering disciplines Mechanical, Electrical and Software, to meet performance, reliability, maintainability, and safety requirements.

• Risk & change control: identify technical risks, propose mitigations, and manage changes while safeguarding architectural integrity.

• Integration & verification: support build, bring-up, test planning, environmental testing (shock, vibration, thermal), and verification reports.

• Reviews & communication: prepare architecture packages and lead design reviews. Communicate decisions and rationales to stakeholders, and ensure documentation is clear and ready for review.

Your background and experience

• BSc/MSc in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or similar.

• Solid systems engineering mindset and preferably a few years of experience from a similar role.

• Experience with functional decomposition, interfaces, requirements, verification/validation, and standards.

• Ability to create clear technical documentation and lead collaborative reviews.

Your new team

In our R&D department you will join more than 270 highly competent and dedicated colleagues. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do, ensuring a seamless transition from design to production. We are dedicated to the ongoing refinement of our processes and the strategic integration of new technologies. We wholeheartedly believe that bringing people with different competencies together will generate the best solutions.

Contact and application

Please apply at our website using the ”Apply” button. The application can be in Danish or English. If you have any questions, you are very welcome to contact Director, Hans Plessing on hap@weibel.dk

The deadline is 16th of November 2026, but we review the applications on an ongoing basis.

Please be aware that it is a requirement for this position that you can provide a criminal record with no remarks and obtain a security clearance.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Bliv en del af en dansk virksomhed

Weibel Scientific A/S er en danskejet ingeniørvirksomhed i kraftig vækst. Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vi er verdensførende inden for udvikling af Doppler-radarer og har siden vores etablering i 1977 leveret flere end 4.500 state-of-the art radarer til mere end 40 lande.

Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

JYSK is strengthening its use of AI to support data-driven decision making, operational efficiency and innovation across the organization. We are now looking for an AI Delivery Lead to join our AI department at the JYSK Head Office.

As AI Delivery Lead, you are responsible for how AI initiatives are delivered – ensuring flow, execution and predictable delivery from idea to production. You work in close collaboration with the AI Product Owner, who owns the what and why, while you own the how and delivery.

In this hybrid role, you will balance driving day-to-day team execution with hands-on contribution to governance strategy.

You will work directly with cross-functional teams - data scientists, AI engineers, data engineers, platform engineers, AI enablement specialists, IT teams, and business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are built, deployed, and adopted with high quality and speed.

You will also direct ownership of key governance tasks, guiding teams toward AI maturity, leading AI and Agent Governance assessments, and navigating compliance requirements for the EU AI Act.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will be responsible for making AI initiatives happen in practice, collaborating closely with teams across JYSK to drive both delivery execution and AI governance maturity.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A hands-on delivery role with clear ownership of how AI solutions are delivered

• Direct impact on shaping JYSK's AI governance, Agent Governance, and EU AI Act compliance roadmap

• Close collaboration with an AI Product Owner and skilled technical specialists

• An international working environment with focus on execution and outcomes

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• Freedom with responsibility in a values-driven organization

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As AI Delivery Lead, you take operational ownership of AI deliveries and drive AI governance initiatives to ensure responsible and compliant deployment. Your key responsibilities include:

• Owning the end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives from planning to production

• Driving execution based on priorities set by the AI Product Owner

• Driving and facilitating planning and delivery activities (such as planning, refinement, daily stand-up, retrospective, demos, etc.)  to ensure steady flow and progress

• Coordinating work across the AI team, IT teams and business stakeholders

• Actively removing impediments and managing dependencies across initiatives

• Following development, progress closely and ensuring timely deployments and handovers

• Ensuring transparency on progress, risks and delivery status

• Supporting good delivery practices

• Leading compliance and maturity activities in AI Governance and Agent Governance

• Conducting AI assessments to ensure solutions align with governance frameworks

• Supporting and guiding teams toward full compliance with the EU AI Act

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a pragmatic and delivery-focused profile who thrives in execution and close collaboration. You enjoy being close to the work, driving team flow, and taking direct responsibility for AI governance and compliance. You likely bring:

• Hands-on experience delivering solutions within AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, data products and similar

**

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take ownership of your workload, manage moderately complex tasks, and help improve processes. You work independently, propose solutions, and adapt quickly when priorities shift. Your solid knowledge makes you a dependable contributor who helps drive team performance.

jobs.description:
_Do you want to join a global fund manager in energy infrastructure investments? If so, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) is currently looking for a Team Assistant to join our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team based in Copenhagen.

Team

We are seeking a motivated and organized Team Assistant to support our team members in our Investor Relations & Business Development (IR & BD) team. The IR & BD team at CIP is a global, high-performing unit responsible for all investor interactions and business development activities—from product and fund development to fundraising and client engagement. The team comprises approximately 70 professionals from 15 countries, with backgrounds in investment banking, management consulting, and law.

You will be also a part of a broader Executive Support team, and will report to Heidi Jensen, Sr. Personal Assistant.

Role

As a Team Assistant based in CIPs Copenhagen office you will be primarily supporting the EMEA team, within the broader Investor Relations team covering clients across the region. You will play a central role both internally and externally, and you will be the closest go-to person for your team in providing broad administrative support.

Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:

• Organizing and maintaining calendars, ensuring alignment in daily schedule and keeping calendars up-to date

• Organizing travel arrangements and logistics and ensuring that roadshows are going smoothly

• Providing broad administrative support, e.g., managing incoming inquiries and scheduling meetings

• Updating CRM systems (e.g., Dealcloud) with relevant data

• Communicating with investors, e.g. replying to emails, sending invitations to events and press releases

You

You have around 5 years of relevant experience in administrative or coordinating roles, preferably from a consulting firm, law firm, investment bank, large international company or a Ministry/Government Agency. You thrive in a high-paced work environment and are motivated, thorough, and resourceful, with a high level of professionalism and able to handle confidential material discreetly.

We look for the following in a candidate

• Solid knowledge of Office 365 applications

• Excellent communication and time management skills

• Ability to balance responsibilities in a busy environment across various projects with changing priorities

• Ability to grasp the big picture at the same time being thorough with a high attention to detail

• Ability to manage administrative processes and projects independently, at the same time enjoying sparring and collaborating with the team

• Resilient, service minded, proactive and with a positive can-do attitude

• Experience with CRM tools is a plus

• Project management – investor events, road shows

The process

Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

Building value that matters

Founded in 2012, Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners P/S (CIP) today is the world’s largest dedicated fund manager within greenfield renewable energy investments and a global leader in offshore wind. To date, CIP has developed and constructed more than +50 greenfield renewable projects around the world. CIP is developing a greenfield project portfolio of ~160GW total, and ~16 GW is in operation or under construction. CIP manages 13 funds and has to date raised approximately EUR ~35 billion for investments in energy and associated infrastructure from more than ~200 international institutional investors.

CIP has a multinational team of ~500 full-time employees with extensive experience and knowledge within the fields of renewable energy project development and regulated infrastructure. In addition, CIP has a broad range of competencies within corporate finance, mergers & acquisitions, engineering, construction, project development, and project management.

CIP has built a prominent investment team capable of originating proprietary investment opportunities and executing projects and investments based on the team’s industrial background, large industrial network, and extensive experience in structuring, executing, and managing investments within energy infrastructure. Headquartered in Copenhagen, CIP also operates from key locations across the globe, including offices in Hamburg, Munich, London, Utrecht, New York, Tokyo, Melbourne, Luxembourg, Kuala Lumpur, Seoul and Singapore. In addition, CIP has 17 local project offices globally.

For more information, visit www.cip.com.

Are you ready to take ownership of a Nordic service organisation and build a more integrated, efficient and customer-focused operation across Denmark and Sweden? Join Ramcon and play a key role in strengthening service performance, developing people and processes, and supporting profitable growth in a specialized Nordic LabTech and MedTech  business.

Ramcon is a leading Nordic distributor of advanced solutions within Life Science, Healthcare, Medical Technology, Chemistry and Industrial applications. Since 1988, the company has built its market position through strong supplier partnerships, deep technical expertise and long-term customer relationships. Today, Ramcon distributes its products and solutions in Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland and employs approximately 80 employees across Denmark and Sweden. The company operates from offices in Birkerød, Aarhus, Stockholm, and Gothenburg.

Lead and develop the Nordic service organisation

The Service Director Nordic will have overarching responsibility for Ramcon’s Nordic service business and will be a member of the Nordic Leadership Team. The position combines people leadership, operational management and business development, with full P&L responsibility for the service business and responsibility for translating strategic ambitions into efficient operations and measurable results.

With direct responsibility for the Danish service business and overarching leadership of the service organisations in Denmark and Sweden, the Service Director Nordic will work closely with local Service Managers and Service Leaders. The role is responsible for building a stable, scalable and customer-focused Nordic service organisation, while strengthening collaboration with Sales, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders.

Key responsibilities include:

• Operational and direct leadership and development of the Nordic service organisation

• P&L responsibility, budgeting and performance follow-up for the Nordic service business

• Leadership and support of local Service Managers and Service Leaders in daily operations and long-term planning

• Standardisation and continuous improvement of service processes across Denmark and Sweden and preparation for local service presence in Norway and Finland

• Resource coordination and effective utilisation of service capacity across the Nordic organisation

• Development, implementation and follow-up of relevant KPIs

• Overarching responsibility for service contract sales and contract renewals

• Strengthening collaboration between Sales and Service and supporting customer-focused commercial execution

• Development of strong relationships and proactive communication with customers and suppliers

• Supporting digitalisation and automation of service workflows

Nordic leadership with operational impact

The Service Director Nordic will play a central role in developing Ramcon’s service organisation into a more integrated Nordic function. Success in the position requires the ability to combine strategic perspective with hands-on operational leadership while creating clear priorities, accountability and collaboration across countries and functions.

The position offers significant influence on how Ramcon delivers service to customers and organises its Nordic resources. The Service Director Nordic will lead an experienced organisation consisting of service engineers, service leadership and service coordination in Denmark and Sweden and will contribute directly to the company’s continued growth and operational development.

Your profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced service leader with a proven track record of creating results through people, structure and disciplined execution in a technical B2B environment. You understand the commercial importance of a high-performing service organisation and can balance customer needs, quality, resource utilization and financial performance.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to have:

• Experience in leading service teams across multiple locations

• Strong people leadership capabilities and experience in developing managers and specialists

• Experience with P&L responsibility, budgeting, KPIs and performance management

• A structured approach to process improvement, resource planning and operational excellence

• Commercial understanding and experience with service agreements, contract sales or renewals

• The ability to build trust and collaboration across customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

• A pragmatic and action-oriented leadership style combined with a strategic Nordic perspective

Experience from Life Science, Diagnostics, Laboratory Solutions, Medical Technology or another specialised technical service environment would be considered very beneficial.

Apply now

The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with the consulting company Compass Human Resources Group. Please submit your CV as soon as possible if you are interested. Please note that all enquiries will be handled with confidentiality and that we will reply to the email address from which you send your CV.

Deadline for application: As soon as possible

Workplace: Ramcon HQ in Birkerød

Reference: 2618.229

Company: Ramcon

_Do you want to shape the future of analytics for the world's largest jewellery brand? Are you passionate about using data, insights, and technology to drive growth, influence strategy, and unlock commercial opportunities? Then you could be the Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights we're looking for.

_As Senior Manager, Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights, you will play a pivotal role in defining and driving Pandora's global eCommerce analytics agenda. This is a highly visible leadership position at the intersection of analytics, commercial strategy, and digital growth.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across Global eCommerce, helping shape business decisions through data-driven insights and strategic recommendations. Leveraging a deep understanding of digital performance, customer behaviour, and commercial drivers, you will identify opportunities to accelerate growth, optimise performance, and strengthen Pandora's global eCommerce business.

Leading a team of analytics professionals, you will combine strategic thinking, business acumen, and analytical expertise to ensure data remains at the heart of decision-making across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities

**Commercial insights & business partnering

• Act as a trusted analytics partner to Global eCommerce leadership, shaping priorities and key business decisions.

• Identify growth opportunities across traffic, conversion, customer and product performance, and turn them into clear commercial recommendations.

• Lead deep dives into the key drivers of eCommerce performance and translate findings into actions that move the business.

Forecasting & performance management

• Own forecasting and performance measurement that support commercial planning and trading decisions.

• Define the KPIs and frameworks used to track and steer eCommerce growth.

• Continuously sharpen analytical approaches and decision-making tools.

Analytics strategy & Centre of Excellence

• Define the analytics strategy, priorities and roadmap for Global eCommerce.

• Lead Pandora's global eCommerce analytics community and set the standard for how analytics creates business value.

• Build analytical and commercial capability across the organisation through coaching and knowledge sharing.

eCommerce analytics platforms

• Act as business owner of Pandora's key eCommerce analytics platforms, ensuring they answer the questions that matter most to the business.

• Lead the Centre of Excellence around these platforms, connecting business needs with technology teams and vendor partners.

• Ensure stakeholders can rely on trusted, decision-ready data.

Team leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing analytics team.

• Build capabilities in analytics, storytelling, and stakeholder engagement.

• Foster a collaborative, curious and commercially minded culture.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**We imagine that you bring significant experience within eCommerce analytics, commercial analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, combined with a passion for translating data into business value and strategic impact.

**Furthermore, We Are Looking For Someone Who Has

**

• Extensive experience working within eCommerce, digital, or commercial analytics environments.

• A strong track record of using analytics and insights to influence business strategy, trading performance, and commercial outcomes.

• Demonstrated success partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions through data-driven recommendations.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to broader commercial objectives.

• Experience identifying growth opportunities and proactively defining analytical priorities and agendas.

• Experience leading and developing high-performing analytics teams.

• Strong knowledge of digital performance analytics, forecasting, experimentation, and performance measurement.

• Experience acting as business owner of web analytics platforms, ideally Adobe Analytics and Contentsquare or similar digital experience analytics tools.

• Experience setting the analytics agenda and ways of working within a global organisation.

• Experience working in complex, matrixed, international environments.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous business questions into actionable analytical approaches.

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage and influence both technical and non-technical audiences.

• A continuous improvement mindset and passion for cultivating data-driven cultures.

**We Hope To See That You Are

**

• A commercially minded analytics leader who naturally connects data to business outcomes.

• A strategic thinker who can see the bigger picture while identifying the key drivers of performance.

• Comfortable moving between executive-level discussions and analytical deep dives.

• Curious, proactive, and confident challenging assumptions with data and insights.

• An inspiring people leader and coach.

• A strong communicator who can simplify complexity and translate analytics into actionable recommendations.

• Skilled at influencing stakeholders across all levels of the organisation.

• Collaborative and relationship-oriented.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-paced international environment.

• Passionate about driving business performance through customer, commercial, and digital insights.

**Your new team

**You will join Pandora's Global eCommerce Analytics & Insights team, a critical function enabling data-driven growth across our global digital business.

Working closely with commercial, trading, marketing, product, technology, and analytics stakeholders, you will help shape the future of eCommerce analytics at Pandora and ensure insights play a central role in how we grow and evolve our digital business.

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band: 4A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site: www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. **About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting, and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion in 2025.

If you’re energized by quality, validation, and complex Automation and IT projects in pharma engineering, we’d love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for an AIT Quality Engineer to join our AIT Project Quality Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, driving, and delivering validation and quality activities within complex Automation and IT projects in the pharmaceutical and life science industry.

You will work as part of multidisciplinary project teams and act as a trusted advisor on validation strategy, GMP compliance, quality risk management, and project quality execution from project initiation through to handover. The role combines hands-on technical validation expertise with project quality management responsibilities, ensuring that deliverables, quality expectations, timelines, and customer requirements are aligned throughout the project lifecycle.

Location Denmark - Kalundborg

Experience Minimum 5 Years

Department AIT Project Quality Management

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As an AIT Quality Engineer, you’ll be:

• Leading CQV and validation activities for automation, IT, computerized systems, and equipment interfaces in GMP-regulated projects.

• Developing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, test protocols, and summary reports.

• Executing qualification and testing activities while ensuring compliance with GMP requirements, industry standards, and customer expectations.

• Collaborating with customers, suppliers, and project teams throughout FAT, SAT, commissioning, validation, and handover.

• Managing validation risks, deviations, compliance issues, and mitigation actions across projects.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Able to work independently while building strong relationships with stakeholders.

• Comfortable balancing compliance, quality, timelines, and project risks.

• Eager to share knowledge and support the development of colleagues.

• Skilled at communicating complex validation topics in a practical way.

• Motivated by collaboration and delivering high-quality results in project environments.

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• A B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent degree in engineering, IT, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related field.

• Experience within CQV, validation, GMP, QA, or project quality management in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or life science industry.

• Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing validation documentation, including URS, FS/DS, SVP, IQ/OQ/PQ, risk assessments, and test protocols.

• Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, ISPE guidance, data integrity, quality risk management, and validation lifecycle management.

• Ability to advise customers and project teams on validation strategy, compliance risks, and quality-related decisions.

**Life at NNE

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Rebecca Larsen at +45 31 91 88 47.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.
